description: Gets a racing series' season by league code, such as f1: the next sessions with their start times, every Grand Prix of the season in round order with its circuit, dates and winner, the latest race's podium, and the drivers' and constructors' championships. Answers "when is the next F1 race", "what time is qualifying" and "who leads the championship".

code.description: The league's code, in any case.

season.description: The season's year; null for the current one.

name: get_league_portal

drivers.description: The drivers' championship as last stored, first place first.

abbreviation.description: The driver's timing-screen code, such as LEC.

athlete.description: The driver's name, on a driver's line.

podiums.description: A driver's top-three finishes in the season's races; null on a team's line.

split.description: On a team's line, its points split between the drivers who scored them, most first; null on a driver's line.

abbreviation.description: The driver's timing-screen code, such as LEC.

percent.description: Those points as a whole percentage of the team's; a team's add up to 100, or are all 0 before it scores.

points.description: The points the driver scored for the team.

teamId.description: The team; on a driver's line, the one they score for.

entrants.description: The teams entered in the season's sessions: whom a calendar of the whole season follows.

lastRace.description: The latest classified race with its podium; null before the season's first.

endTime.description: When it is due to end; null when the provider gives no length.

lap.description: While a race or sprint is live, the lap the leader is on, when the provider counts it.

laps.description: While a race or sprint is live, the laps it is planned to run.

meetingSlug.description: The meeting's evergreen slug, such as monaco-grand-prix.

name.description: The stage as an event names it, such as Qualifying.

status.description: classified, dnf, dns, dsq or nc.

time.description: In a race or sprint, the winner's time or another car's interval to it (+12.594, +1 Lap); in practice or qualifying, the car's best lap (1:13.978).

stage.description: The stage's code, such as qualifying or race.

state.description: scheduled, live, final, cancelled or postponed.

trackUrl.description: The meeting's track outline, its mark on a card; null when that season's circuit isn't drawn.
